sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Euro Truck Heavy Vehicle Transport Game 3D are centered around driving and transporting vehicles. Players control their truck using the keyboard arrow keys, navigating through city streets and off-road terrain while avoiding obstacles and collisions. The game features a physics engine that simulates real-world truck driving, making the experience even more immersive and realistic.

One of the most exciting aspects of the game is the variety of vehicles players can transport. From luxury cars to heavy vehicles, each vehicle has its unique specifications and handling characteristics. Players must adapt their driving style to suit the vehicle they're transporting, making the game even more challenging and engaging.

The game also features a day-night cycle and weather system, which adds to the realism and immersion of the gameplay. Players must adjust their driving style to suit the time of day and weather conditions, making the game even more dynamic and responsive.
